verses.original: אַחֲרֵי־ כֵ֗ן פָּתַ֤ח אִיּוֹב֙ אֶת־ פִּ֔יהוּ וַיְקַלֵּ֖ל אֶת־ יוֹמֽוֹ׃פ
verses.transliteration: ’a·ḥă·rê- ḵên pā·ṯaḥ ’î·yō·wḇ ’eṯ- pî·hū way·qal·lêl ’eṯ- yō·w·mōw
verses.literal: After this Job opened his mouth and cursed the day of his birth
verses.literalPt: DEPOIS disto abriu Jó a sua boca, e amaldiçoou o seu dia.

verses.original: וַיַּ֥עַן אִיּ֗וֹב וַיֹּאמַֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘an ’î·yō·wḇ way·yō·mar
verses.literal: And this is what he said
verses.literalPt: E Jó, falando, disse:

verses.original: יֹ֣אבַד י֭וֹם אִוָּ֣לֶד בּ֑וֹ וְהַלַּ֥יְלָה אָ֝מַ֗ר הֹ֣רָה גָֽבֶר׃
verses.transliteration: yō·ḇaḏ yō·wm ’iw·wā·leḏ bōw wə·hal·lay·lāh ’ā·mar hō·rāh ḡā·ḇer
verses.literal: May the day of my birth perish and the night it was said A boy is conceived
verses.literalPt: Pereça o dia em que nasci, e a noite em que se disse: Foi concebido um homem!

verses.original: הַיּ֥וֹם הַה֗וּא יְֽהִ֫י חֹ֥שֶׁךְ אַֽל־ יִדְרְשֵׁ֣הוּ אֱל֣וֹהַּ מִמָּ֑עַל וְאַל־ תּוֹפַ֖ע עָלָ֣יו נְהָרָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: hay·yō·wm ha·hū yə·hî ḥō·šeḵ ’al- yiḏ·rə·šê·hū ’ĕ·lō·w·ah mim·mā·‘al wə·’al- tō·w·p̄a‘ ‘ā·lāw nə·hā·rāh
verses.literal: If only that day had turned to darkness May God above . . . disregard it may no light shine upon it
verses.literalPt: Converta-se aquele dia em trevas; e Deus, lá de cima, não tenha cuidado dele, nem resplandeça sobre ele a luz.

verses.original: יִגְאָלֻ֡הוּ חֹ֣שֶׁךְ וְ֭צַלְמָוֶת תִּשְׁכָּן־ עָלָ֣יו עֲנָנָ֑ה יְ֝בַעֲתֻ֗הוּ כִּֽמְרִ֥ירֵי יֽוֹם׃
verses.transliteration: yiḡ·’ā·lu·hū ḥō·šeḵ wə·ṣal·mā·weṯ tiš·kān- ‘ā·lāw ‘ă·nā·nāh yə·ḇa·‘ă·ṯu·hū kim·rî·rê yō·wm
verses.literal: May darkness and gloom reclaim it and a cloud settle over it may the blackness of the day overwhelm it
verses.literalPt: Contaminem-no as trevas e a sombra da morte; habitem sobre ele nuvens; a escuridão do dia o espante!

verses.original: הַלַּ֥יְלָה הַהוּא֮ יִקָּחֵ֪ה֫וּ אֹ֥פֶל אַל־ יִ֭חַדְּ בִּימֵ֣י שָׁנָ֑ה בְּמִסְפַּ֥ר יְ֝רָחִ֗ים אַל־ יָבֹֽא׃
verses.transliteration: hal·lay·lāh ha·hū yiq·qā·ḥê·hū ’ō·p̄el ’al- yi·ḥad bî·mê šā·nāh bə·mis·par yə·rā·ḥîm ’al- yā·ḇō
verses.literal: If only darkness had taken that night away May it not appear among the days of the year may it never be entered in any of the months
verses.literalPt: Quanto àquela noite, dela se apodere a escuridão; e não se regozije ela entre os dias do ano; e não entre no número dos meses!

verses.original: הִנֵּ֤ה הַלַּ֣יְלָה הַ֭הוּא יְהִ֣י גַלְמ֑וּד אַל־ תָּבֹ֖א רְנָנָ֣ה בֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: hin·nêh hal·lay·lāh ha·hū yə·hî ḡal·mūḏ ’al- tā·ḇō rə·nā·nāh ḇōw
verses.literal: Behold may that night be barren may no joyful voice come into it
verses.literalPt: Ah! que solitária seja aquela noite, e nela não entre voz de júbilo!

verses.original: יִקְּבֻ֥הוּ אֹרְרֵי־ י֑וֹם הָ֝עֲתִידִ֗ים עֹרֵ֥ר לִוְיָתָֽן׃
verses.transliteration: yiq·qə·ḇu·hū ’ō·rə·rê- yō·wm hā·‘ă·ṯî·ḏîm ‘ō·rêr liw·yā·ṯān
verses.literal: May it be cursed by those who curse the day those prepared to rouse Leviathan
verses.literalPt: Amaldiçoem-na aqueles que amaldiçoam o dia, que estão prontos para suscitar o seu pranto.

verses.original: יֶחְשְׁכוּ֮ כּוֹכְבֵ֪י נִ֫שְׁפּ֥וֹ יְקַו־ לְא֥וֹר וָאַ֑יִן וְאַל־ יִ֝רְאֶ֗ה בְּעַפְעַפֵּי־ שָֽׁחַר׃
verses.transliteration: yeḥ·šə·ḵū kō·wḵ·ḇê niš·pōw yə·qaw- lə·’ō·wr wā·’a·yin wə·’al- yir·’eh bə·‘ap̄·‘ap·pê- šā·ḥar
verses.literal: May its morning stars grow dark may it wait in vain for daylight may it not see the breaking of dawn
verses.literalPt: Escureçam-se as estrelas do seu crepúsculo; que espere a luz, e não venha; e não veja as pálpebras da alva;

verses.original: כִּ֤י לֹ֣א סָ֭גַר דַּלְתֵ֣י בִטְנִ֑י וַיַּסְתֵּ֥ר עָ֝מָ֗ל מֵעֵינָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: kî lō sā·ḡar dal·ṯê ḇiṭ·nî way·yas·têr ‘ā·māl mê·‘ê·nāy
verses.literal: For that night did not shut the doors of the womb to hide the sorrow from my eyes
verses.literalPt: Porque não fechou as portas do ventre; nem escondeu dos meus olhos a canseira.

verses.original: לָ֤מָּה לֹּ֣א מֵרֶ֣חֶם אָמ֑וּת מִבֶּ֖טֶן יָצָ֣אתִי וְאֶגְוָֽע׃
verses.transliteration: lām·māh lō mê·re·ḥem ’ā·mūṯ mib·be·ṭen yā·ṣā·ṯî wə·’eḡ·wā‘
verses.literal: Why did I not perish at birth why did I not die as I came from the womb
verses.literalPt: Por que não morri eu desde a madre? E em saindo do ventre, não expirei?

verses.original: מַ֭דּוּעַ קִדְּמ֣וּנִי בִרְכָּ֑יִם וּמַה־ שָּׁ֝דַ֗יִם כִּ֣י אִינָֽק׃
verses.transliteration: mad·dū·a‘ qid·də·mū·nî ḇir·kā·yim ū·ma·hō·šā- šā·d̲a·yim kî ’î·nāq
verses.literal: Why were there knees to receive me and breasts that I should be nursed
verses.literalPt: Por que me receberam os joelhos? E por que os peitos, para que mamasse?

verses.original: כִּֽי־ עַ֭תָּה שָׁכַ֣בְתִּי וְאֶשְׁק֑וֹט יָ֝שַׁ֗נְתִּי אָ֤ז׀ יָנ֬וּחַֽ לִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ‘at·tāh šā·ḵaḇ·tî wə·’eš·qō·wṭ yā·šan·tî ’āz yā·nū·aḥ lî
verses.literal: For now I would be lying down in peace I would be asleep and at rest
verses.literalPt: Porque já agora jazeria e repousaria; dormiria, e então haveria repouso para mim.

verses.original: עִם־ מְ֭לָכִים וְיֹ֣עֲצֵי אָ֑רֶץ הַבֹּנִ֖ים חֳרָב֣וֹת לָֽמוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ‘im- mə·lā·ḵîm wə·yō·‘ă·ṣê ’ā·reṣ hab·bō·nîm ḥo·rā·ḇō·wṯ lā·mōw
verses.literal: with kings and counselors of the earth who built for themselves cities now in ruins
verses.literalPt: Com os reis e conselheiros da terra, que para si edificam casas nos lugares assolados,

verses.original: א֣וֹ עִם־ שָׂ֭רִים זָהָ֣ב לָהֶ֑ם הַֽמְמַלְאִ֖ים בָּתֵּיהֶ֣ם כָּֽסֶף׃
verses.transliteration: ’ōw ‘i·m·śā- śā·rîm zā·hāḇ lā·hem ham·mal·’îm bāt·tê·hem kā·sep̄
verses.literal: or with princes who had gold . . . who filled their houses with silver
verses.literalPt: Ou com os príncipes que possuem ouro, que enchem as suas casas de prata,

verses.original: א֤וֹ כְנֵ֣פֶל טָ֭מוּן לֹ֣א אֶהְיֶ֑ה כְּ֝עֹלְלִ֗ים לֹא־ רָ֥אוּ אֽוֹר׃
verses.transliteration: ’ōw ḵə·nê·p̄el ṭā·mūn lō ’eh·yeh kə·‘ō·lə·lîm lō- rā·’ū ’ō·wr
verses.literal: Or why was I not hidden like a stillborn child like an infant who never sees daylight
verses.literalPt: Ou como aborto oculto, não existiria; como as crianças que não viram a luz.

verses.original: שָׁ֣ם רְ֭שָׁעִים חָ֣דְלוּ רֹ֑גֶז וְשָׁ֥ם יָ֝נ֗וּחוּ יְגִ֣יעֵי כֹֽחַ׃
verses.transliteration: šām rə·šā·‘îm ḥā·ḏə·lū rō·ḡez wə·šām yā·nū·ḥū yə·ḡî·‘ê ḵō·aḥ
verses.literal: There the wicked cease from raging and there the weary . . . find rest
verses.literalPt: Ali os maus cessam de perturbar; e ali repousam os cansados.

verses.original: יַ֭חַד אֲסִירִ֣ים שַׁאֲנָ֑נוּ לֹ֥א שָׁ֝מְע֗וּ ק֣וֹל נֹגֵֽשׂ׃
verses.transliteration: ya·ḥaḏ ’ă·sî·rîm ša·’ă·nā·nū lō šā·mə·ʿû qō·wl nō·ḡêś
verses.literal: The captives enjoy their ease they do not hear the voice of the oppressor
verses.literalPt: Ali os presos juntamente repousam, e não ouvem a voz do exator.

verses.original: קָטֹ֣ן וְ֭גָדוֹל שָׁ֣ם ה֑וּא וְ֝עֶ֗בֶד חָפְשִׁ֥י מֵאֲדֹנָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: qā·ṭōn wə·ḡā·ḏō·wl šām hū wə·‘e·ḇeḏ ḥā·p̄ə·šî mê·’ă·ḏō·nāw
verses.literal: Both small and great are there . . . and the slave is freed from his master
verses.literalPt: Ali está o pequeno e o grande, e o servo livre de seu senhor.

verses.original: לָ֤מָּה יִתֵּ֣ן לְעָמֵ֣ל א֑וֹר וְ֝חַיִּ֗ים לְמָ֣רֵי נָֽפֶשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: lām·māh yit·tên lə·‘ā·mêl ’ō·wr wə·ḥay·yîm lə·mā·rê nā·p̄eš
verses.literal: Why is light given to the miserable and life to the bitter of soul
verses.literalPt: Por que se dá luz ao miserável, e vida aos amargurados de ânimo?

verses.original: הַֽמְחַכִּ֣ים לַמָּ֣וֶת וְאֵינֶ֑נּוּ וַֽ֝יַּחְפְּרֻ֗הוּ מִמַּטְמוֹנִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ham·ḥak·kîm lam·mā·weṯ wə·’ê·nen·nū way·yaḥ·pə·ru·hū mim·maṭ·mō·w·nîm
verses.literal: who long for death that does not come and search for it like hidden treasure
verses.literalPt: Que esperam a morte, e ela não vem; e cavam em procura dela mais do que de tesouros ocultos;

verses.original: הַשְּׂמֵחִ֥ים אֱלֵי־ גִ֑יל יָ֝שִׂ֗ישׂוּ כִּ֣י יִמְצְאוּ־ קָֽבֶר׃
verses.transliteration: haś·śə·mê·ḥîm ’ĕ·lê- ḡîl yā·śî·śū kî yim·ṣə·’ū- qā·ḇer
verses.literal: who rejoice . . . and greatly exult when they reach the grave
verses.literalPt: Que de alegria saltam, e exultam, achando a sepultura?

verses.original: לְ֭גֶבֶר אֲשֶׁר־ דַּרְכּ֣וֹ נִסְתָּ֑רָה וַיָּ֖סֶךְ אֱל֣וֹהַּ בַּעֲדֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: lə·ḡe·ḇer ’ă·šer- dar·kōw nis·tā·rāh way·yā·seḵ ’ĕ·lō·w·ah ba·‘ă·ḏōw
verses.literal: Why is life given to a man whose way is hidden whom God . . . has hedged in
verses.literalPt: Por que se dá luz ao homem, cujo caminho é oculto, e a quem Deus o encobriu?

verses.original: כִּֽי־ לִפְנֵ֣י לַ֭חְמִי אַנְחָתִ֣י תָבֹ֑א וַֽיִּתְּכ֥וּ כַ֝מַּ֗יִם שַׁאֲגֹתָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: kî- lip̄·nê laḥ·mî ’an·ḥā·ṯî ṯā·ḇō way·yit·tə·ḵū ḵam·ma·yim ša·’ă·ḡō·ṯāy
verses.literal: I sigh when food is put before me and my groans pour out like water
verses.literalPt: Porque antes do meu pão vem o meu suspiro; e os meus gemidos se derramam como água.

verses.original: כִּ֤י פַ֣חַד פָּ֭חַדְתִּי וַיֶּאֱתָיֵ֑נִי וַאֲשֶׁ֥ר יָ֝גֹ֗רְתִּי יָ֣בֹא לִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: kî p̄a·ḥaḏ pā·ḥaḏ·tî way·ye·’ĕ·ṯā·yê·nî wa·’ă·šer yā·ḡō·rə·tî yā·ḇō lî
verses.literal: For the thing I feared has overtaken me and what I dreaded has befallen me
verses.literalPt: Porque aquilo que temia me sobreveio; e o que receava me aconteceu.

verses.original: לֹ֤א שָׁלַ֨וְתִּי׀ וְלֹ֖א שָׁקַ֥טְתִּי וְֽלֹא־ נָ֗חְתִּי וַיָּ֥בֹא רֹֽגֶז׃פ
verses.transliteration: lō šā·law·tî wə·lō šā·qaṭ·tî wə·lō- nā·ḥə·tî way·yā·ḇō rō·ḡez
verses.literal: I am not at ease or quiet . . . I have no rest for trouble has come
verses.literalPt: Nunca estive tranqüilo, nem sosseguei, nem repousei, mas veio sobre mim a perturbação.
